candidates.title: Hippocratic prognosis constructor with cause and time scope

source_pin.span: Complete Part2, H01–H10; Adams English digital witness, not an established medieval Latin exemplar

candidates.whole_hypothesis: The record instructs examination, inquiry and prognosis rather than treatment. Compare a patient’s appearance to healthy people and especially their own healthy baseline. Record the adverse face bundle. At onset ask about loss of sleep, loose bowels and want of food; a confessed explanation lowers danger but does not promise survival. Reassess over a day and night. Retain the source’s unresolved relation between absent causes and persistent signs in the severe branch. At the third/fourth day repeat those inquiries and add the face, body and eye observations. Keep later eyelid/sleep exclusions, severity levels, nasal motion and the final mortal-lips assertion.
candidates.new_design_offer: Author two full accounts under one prospective grammar: JUDGMENT treats the observed bundle as evidence for a qualified proposition; THERAPEUTIC treats a comparable construction as an instruction or achieved change. Preserve the same provisional feature names, observed patient and time fields. Compare semantic output sorts and entailment, not count of filled slots. This is a new exploratory whole-reading comparison, not an executed manuscript test.
candidates.multistep_meaning_consequence: Appearance remains the same when reported history changes the warranted prognosis. EXPLAINED_BY(finding,cause) produces reduced danger, not disappearance of the finding or guaranteed safety. The inquiry/time scopes must distinguish observation, explanation and judgment. No later invented consumer is required for that assertion-content distinction.
candidates.smallest_adequate_case: One complete root-nominated admitted paragraph containing a possible observation plus history query/condition and explicit judgment, with all its words retained. The source owns ten sections, not an instruction to force ten target clauses. Root may attempt an exploratory reading before this capacity is known.
candidates.eventual_falsifier: Freeze one whole model and scope policy. Reject if an admitted explanation necessarily erases the appearance, entails recovery, changes the patient, or makes the severe judgment unconditional despite retained history/time expressions. UNKNOWN if the relevant groups remain unread; a coherent source paraphrase is not manuscript confirmation.
candidates.written_composition_task: Try one finite directed operation that closes a typed finding/judgment within licensed wholes, with exact-whole residuals distinguishing assertion from inquiry or intention. At least two supported forms must actually share its argument interface. Do not assign aN, q, r/l or k/t English meanings from the formal profiles.

candidates.title: Complete accusation narrative with rebuttals and a non-entailing outcome

source_pin.span: Complete15-line Lupus et Agnus; IntraText Latin witness ancestry uncollated, no Voynich exemplar claim

candidates.whole_hypothesis: Two thirsty participants occupy different places at one stream. One alleges fouling against the other; the other rejects it using the direction of flow, and the narrator endorses the rebuttal. A second allegation concerns an offense six months earlier; the accused had not yet been born. The accuser shifts that alleged offense to the accused’s father, a new related person whose offense remains unverified. The accuser nevertheless kills the accused unjustly. The concluding generalization concerns oppression using invented causes, not proof of the accusations.
candidates.new_design_offer: Explore a complete reported-evidence account against a direct-fact account under a common finite written argument/scope grammar. The core next difference is temporal existence and referent shift, not another flow/reciprocal comparison. Keep actions separate from evidential endorsement. Do not run raw415 unchanged because its evaluator text has an internal direction defect.
candidates.multistep_meaning_consequence: An allegation can be reported then rebutted without becoming a narrator assertion. Birth later than an alleged offense defeats that allegation; introducing a father changes the alleged agent, not the referent of every earlier pronoun. The final completed violent action neither proves the old allegations nor makes the father’s unverified charge true.

primary_internal_defect.actual_evaluation: ALLEGES is REPORTED and does not update world truth. REBUTS evaluates a claim from typed facts: an upstream-fouling claim fails when water flows from accused downstream participant to accuser; an earlier-offense claim fails when the alleged agent does not EXIST_AT the alleged time. DOES remains executable after REBUTS.
primary_internal_defect.counterfactual: Generate the same typed record with FLOW reversed to LAMB_DRINKING_PLACE -> WOLF_DRINKING_PLACE. The constructor then no longer rejects the muddy-water allegation. Separately set LAMB_BIRTH earlier than SIX_MONTHS_BEFORE_NOW; the temporal rebuttal then disappears. The final DOES(KILL) remains a separate action in both variants. A flat true-event list, a rebuttal-blocks-action rule, or an outcome-implies-truth rule predicts a different result.

Hippocratic_H01_H10.content: In acute disease examine the countenance first. Similarity to healthy people is favorable, similarity to the patient’s own healthy appearance more favorable; the most opposed appearance is worst.

Retain the full adverse-face description: sharp nose; hollow eyes; collapsed temples; cold contracted ears with turned-out lobes; rough, distended and parched forehead skin; whole-face color green, black, livid or lead-colored.
At disease onset, if that appearance is not accounted for by other symptoms, inquire about prolonged sleeplessness, very loose bowels and lack of food.
If any of those causes is admitted, danger is judged less. A day and night makes apparent whether the countenance arose from these causes. Reduced danger does not mean guaranteed survival.

The two written if-clauses concern none of those causes being reported and symptoms not subsiding in the aforementioned interval, followed by imminent-death prognosis. Their exact conjunction/scope is not silently resolved from this English translation.

At the more advanced third or fourth day with the same appearance, repeat the same inquiries and attend to other signs on the whole face, body and eyes. This is a genuine backward procedural reference, not a new independent question list.

Keep every further adverse sign: eyes shunning light, involuntary tears, squint, unequal size, red or livid whites or black veins, gum, restlessness, protrusion or marked hollowness; a squalid dark countenance or changed whole-face color. The passage calls these bad and fatal.

Observe eyes during sleep: exposed white because lids do not close, with written exclusions mentioning diarrhea, medicinal purgation and the patient’s habitual sleep appearance. Preserve the printed and/or connective ambiguity; do not silently replace it with a medical rule preferred by the analyst.
Contracted, livid or pale eyelid, lip or nose together with some other signs entails imminent death in the source’s historical claim.
The final separate assertion calls relaxed, pendent, cold and blanched lips a mortal sign. Do not omit it merely because the first temporal contrast supplied the proposed discriminator.

Phaedrus_F01_F10.content: The wolf and lamb reach the same stream because of thirst; wolf stands above, lamb far below. Same stream is not a claim that one indivisible water portion is reused.
Narrator calls the wolf a robber and gives fauce improba as the motive for starting a quarrel. Ravenous/malicious appetite is an interpretation; the expression is preserved in the Latin.
Wolf alleges the lamb has muddied the water for him while he drinks. The question carries an accusation, not an authorial assertion that muddying occurred.
The fearful wool-bearer, identified as the lamb by continuity, asks how that is possible: water flows from the wolf to the lamb’s drinking place. The flow objection concerns causal direction.
Narrator says the wolf was repulsed by the force of truth; this licenses endorsement of the rebuttal within the story.
Wolf alleges a verbal offense against himself six months earlier.
Lamb answers that it had not yet been born; temporal existence is the second, independent prerequisite for the alleged action.

Wolf substitutes the lamb’s father as alleged offender. Father is a new participant related to the lamb, not a pronoun or synonym for the lamb. No reply establishes whether the father actually offended.
Wolf seizes and tears the lamb in an unjust killing. A completed violent outcome does not turn the earlier charges into facts.
The narrator explicitly says the fable is written against people who oppress the innocent with invented causes. The general moral and authorial purpose belong to the complete content.
